notes:
Fixes from a six-part review (strategies, delays, price data, trade safety, consistency, security).
- Safety: the LIVE confirmation shows each loss limit as ON with its value or OFF, and warns when no loss limit is active (all are off by default).
- Safety: right before the click the bot re-checks the pair, the account (demo/live), live confirmation and that auto-trade is still on; any change aborts the trade.
- Safety: entry deadline. The click must happen within 30% of the candle (at least 1 s, at most 3 s) after the signal candle closed, otherwise the trade is skipped ("Too late to enter").
- Safety: only one thing drives the Time / Investment boxes and the chart period at a time; no trade while the chart is being switched; no trade while the broker socket is closed or in the 2 s after it reopens.
- Safety: a trade whose result is missing 15 s after expiry counts as a provisional loss for stop-loss, losses in a row and cooldown until the result arrives; a broker result that arrives after the 10-minute estimate replaces it. Nothing is counted twice.
